senses.definition: n.[m.] house, palace—abs. הַבִּיתָן Est 7:7, 8 (גִּנַּת הב׳) cstr. בִּיתַן Est 1:5 (גִּנַּת ב׳ הַמֶּלֶךְ), all garden of בּ׳; according to DieulafoyRÉJ 1888, cclxxvii. throne-room, syn. of apadâna in meaning, but cf. אַפֶּדֶן.
